title: Scholarships
content: SRMIST offers a wide range of scholarships to support meritorious and deserving students. The key scholarship schemes include: 1. SRM Founder's Scholarship: Offers a 100% tuition fee waiver, free hostel accommodation, and a monthly stipend for top rankers in SRMJEEE, JEE Main top 2000 rankers, state board toppers, and national level sports medalists. 2. Merit Scholarship: Provides a 25% to 75% tuition fee waiver based on high scores in SRMJEEE or CBSE/State Board exams. 3. Socio-Economic Scholarship: Offers fee concessions to economically challenged students, ward of martyrs, or differently-abled individuals. 4. Sports Scholarship: Tuition and hostel fee waiver for students representing the state or country in recognized sports. 5. SRM Merit-cum-Means Scholarship: Awarded to students with good academic performance and low family income. Scholarships are renewed annually subject to maintaining a minimum CGPA of 7.0/8.0 (depending on the scholarship category) and having no backlogs or disciplinary records.
